```{r}
#| label: setup
#| output: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
# Load the project's functions from the checkout (decision 0042) and read the
# published data bundle, so this code reproduces the figure (decision 0040).
root <- Sys.getenv("CFB2NFL_ROOT")
if (!nzchar(root)) {
  root <- pkgload::pkg_path()
}
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = root)
pkgload::load_all(root, quiet = TRUE)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggiraph)

con <- DBI::dbConnect(
  duckdb::duckdb(),
  file.path(root, "data", "cfb2nfl.duckdb"),
  read_only = TRUE
)
release <- data_release_date()
first_season <- 2013L
last_season <- 2025L # the 2026 season is still being played
tier_order <- c("Power", "Group of 5", "FCS and below")
credited <- tbl(con, "team_draft") |>
  filter(season >= first_season, season <= last_season) |>
  collect() |>
  mutate(tier_label = factor(tier_label, levels = tier_order))
team_season_all <- tbl(con, "team_season") |>
  filter(season <= last_season) |>
  select(team, season, classification, conference) |>
  collect()
DBI::dbDisconnect(con, shutdown = TRUE)
```

```{r}
#| label: compute
tier_rates <- draft_rates(group_by(credited, tier_label))
tr <- function(t, col) tier_rates[[col]][tier_rates$tier_label == t]
power_g5_udfa <- tr("Power", "udfa_rate") / tr("Group of 5", "udfa_rate")
fbs_cr <- credited |>
  filter(tier_label != "FCS and below") |>
  mutate(
    league = case_when(
      conference == "FBS Independents" & team == "Notre Dame" ~ "Notre Dame",
      conference == "FBS Independents" ~ "Other FBS independents",
      .default = conference
    )
  )
league_tier <- fbs_cr |>
  count(league, tier_label, wt = n_eligible) |>
  group_by(league) |>
  slice_max(n, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  ungroup() |>
  select(league, tier = tier_label)
conf_rates <- draft_rates(group_by(fbs_cr, league)) |>
  left_join(league_tier, by = "league") |>
  arrange(draft_rate)
```

```{r}
#| label: figure
dumb <- conf_rates |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    c(draft_rate, udfa_rate),
    names_to = "outcome",
    values_to = "rate"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    outcome = if_else(
      outcome == "draft_rate",
      "Drafted",
      "Undrafted free agent"
    ),
    league = factor(league, levels = conf_rates$league)
  )
p <- ggplot(dumb, aes(rate, league)) +
  geom_line(aes(group = league), color = "grey75", linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_point_interactive(
    aes(
      color = outcome,
      tooltip = paste0(
        league,
        ": ",
        pct(rate),
        " of ",
        fmt(eligible),
        " eligible players ",
        tolower(outcome)
      ),
      data_id = paste(league, outcome)
    ),
    size = 3.5
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("Drafted" = "#374151", "Undrafted free agent" = "#9ca3af"),
    name = NULL
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  labs(
    title = "Draft and undrafted rates by conference",
    subtitle = "Eligible players drafted (dark grey) and signed undrafted (mid grey)",
    x = "Share of eligible players",
    y = NULL,
    caption = card_caption(release)
  ) +
  theme_card()

card_thumbnail(
  p,
  "undrafted-signings-by-conference",
  release = release,
  height = 8
)
card_interactive(p)
```

```{r}
#| label: table
bind_rows(
  tier_rates |>
    filter(tier_label != "FCS and below") |>
    transmute(
      Group = paste("All", tier_label),
      eligible,
      drafted,
      udfa,
      draft_rate,
      udfa_rate
    ),
  conf_rates |>
    transmute(Group = league, eligible, drafted, udfa, draft_rate, udfa_rate)
) |>
  transmute(
    Group,
    Eligible = fmt(eligible),
    Drafted = fmt(drafted),
    `Draft rate` = pct(draft_rate),
    `Undrafted free agents` = fmt(udfa),
    `Undrafted rate` = pct(udfa_rate)
  ) |>
  knitr::kable(
    col.names = c(
      "Group",
      "Eligible players",
      "Drafted",
      "Draft rate",
      "Undrafted free agents",
      "Undrafted rate"
    ),
    caption = sprintf(
      "Draft and undrafted rates by FBS tier and conference, final seasons %s to %s. Power players were drafted at %.1f times the Group of 5 rate but signed undrafted at %.1f times it.",
      first_season,
      last_season,
      tr("Power", "draft_rate") / tr("Group of 5", "draft_rate"),
      power_g5_udfa
    )
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: school-divisions
# Every school in every division, coloured by its latest FBS conference
# (pale grey outside FBS) and shaped by its latest division.
school_div <- school_division(team_season_all, last_season)
conf_colors <- conference_palette()
all_cr <- inner_join(credited, school_div, by = "team")
# Schools and school position groups with few eligible players swing on one
# or two signings, so they drop out.
min_eligible <- 10L
school_all_n <- draft_rates(group_by(all_cr, team)) |>
  inner_join(school_div, by = "team")
school_all <- filter(school_all_n, eligible >= min_eligible)
n_small_schools <- nrow(school_all_n) - nrow(school_all)
n_div <- count(school_all, division)
div_note <- paste(
  paste(fmt(n_div$n), n_div$division),
  collapse = ", "
)
school_pos_all <- school_position_rates(all_cr)
school_pos <- school_pos_all |>
  filter(eligible >= min_eligible) |>
  inner_join(school_div, by = "team")
n_small <- nrow(school_pos_all) - nrow(school_pos)
school_label <- \(d) {
  paste0(
    d$team,
    " (",
    if_else(
      d$division == "FBS",
      d$conference_group,
      as.character(d$division)
    ),
    ")"
  )
}
conference_scales <- list(
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = conf_colors,
    breaks = names(conf_colors),
    name = NULL
  ),
  scale_shape_manual(values = division_shapes(), name = NULL),
  guides(
    colour = guide_legend(order = 1, override.aes = list(size = 4)),
    shape = guide_legend(order = 2, override.aes = list(size = 4))
  )
)
```

```{r}
#| label: schools
p_schools <- ggplot(school_all, aes(draft_rate, udfa_rate)) +
  geom_abline(
    slope = 1,
    intercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "#6b7280"
  ) +
  geom_point_interactive(
    aes(
      colour = conference_group,
      shape = division,
      size = eligible,
      tooltip = paste0(
        school_label(school_all),
        "\n",
        drafted,
        " drafted, ",
        udfa,
        " undrafted free agents, of ",
        eligible,
        " eligible"
      ),
      data_id = team
    ),
    alpha = 0.85
  ) +
  conference_scales +
  scale_size_area(max_size = 6, guide = "none") +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  labs(
    x = "Draft rate",
    y = "Undrafted rate",
    title = "Every school's draft and undrafted rates, by conference and division",
    subtitle = sprintf(
      "Schools by division: %s; final seasons %s to %s\n%s schools with fewer than %s eligible players left out\nColour is the latest FBS conference, shape the division; on the dashed line, as many drafted as signed undrafted",
      div_note,
      first_season,
      last_season,
      fmt(n_small_schools),
      min_eligible
    ),
    caption = card_caption(release)
  ) +
  theme_cfb2nfl() +
  theme(
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = rel(0.8)),
    legend.position = "right"
  )
card_interactive(p_schools, height_svg = 7.5)
```

```{r}
#| label: schools-by-position
p_school_pos <- ggplot(school_pos, aes(draft_rate, udfa_rate)) +
  geom_abline(
    slope = 1,
    intercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "#6b7280"
  ) +
  geom_point_interactive(
    aes(
      colour = conference_group,
      shape = division,
      size = eligible,
      tooltip = paste0(
        school_label(school_pos),
        ", ",
        tolower(position_group),
        "\n",
        drafted,
        " drafted, ",
        udfa,
        " undrafted free agents, of ",
        eligible,
        " eligible"
      ),
      data_id = team
    ),
    alpha = 0.85
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~position_group, ncol = 3) +
  conference_scales +
  scale_size_area(max_size = 4, guide = "none") +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  labs(
    x = "Draft rate",
    y = "Undrafted rate",
    title = "Every school's draft and undrafted rates, by position group",
    subtitle = sprintf(
      "Colour is the latest FBS conference, shape the division; on the dashed line, as many drafted as undrafted\n%s school position groups with fewer than %s eligible players left out; hover a dot to find its school in every group",
      fmt(n_small),
      min_eligible
    ),
    caption = card_caption(release)
  ) +
  theme_cfb2nfl() +

card_interactive(p_school_pos, height_svg = 10)
```

```{r}
#| label: udfa-gap
pos_subtitle <- \(reading) {
  sprintf(
    "Each dot is a school in one position group, final seasons %s to %s; %s\nColour is the latest FBS conference, shape the division; %s school position groups with fewer than %s eligible players left out",
    first_season,
    last_season,
    reading,
    fmt(n_small),
    min_eligible
  )
}
p_udfa_gap <- school_pos |>
  mutate(
    tip = paste0(
      school_label(school_pos),
      ", ",
      tolower(position_group),
      "\n",
      drafted,
      " drafted, ",
      udfa,
      " undrafted free agents, of ",
      eligible,
      " eligible"
    )
  ) |>
  gap_beeswarm(
    udfa_gap,
    conference_group,
    conf_colors,
    tip,
    title = "Undrafted rate minus draft rate, by school and position group",
    subtitle = pos_subtitle("right of zero, more signed undrafted than drafted"),
    x_label = "Undrafted rate minus draft rate (percentage points)",
    caption = card_caption(release),
    shape = division,
    shapes = division_shapes()
  ) +
  theme(legend.position = "right")
card_interactive(p_udfa_gap, height_svg = 8)
```

```{r}
#| label: entry-gap
p_entry_gap <- school_pos |>

      school_label(school_pos),

      " did not, of ",

    entry_gap,
    conference_group,
    conf_colors,

    ),
    x_label = "Rate not entering the NFL minus rate entering (percentage points)",
    caption = card_caption(release),
    shape = division,

  ) +

card_interactive(p_entry_gap, height_svg = 8)
```
